name: Unleash
summary: The open source edition of Unleash is free but limited to 1 project, 2 environments and 5,000 flags per instance. Its paid Pay-As-You-Go plan costs $75 per seat per month on a monthly card with no contract. Enterprise annual contracts are quoted.

facts.text: Pay-As-You-Go includes 53M API requests a month on Cloud, then $5 per million, and a self-hosted install needs a 5-seat minimum.
The open source edition has no seat limit and no support SLA.
Server-side SDKs cover Go, Java, Node.js, PHP, Python, Ruby, Rust and .NET, and client-side SDKs cover Android, Flutter, iOS, JavaScript, Next.js, React, React Native, Svelte and Vue.
A gradual rollout exposes a feature to a set percentage of users using a hash of the user ID, so each user keeps a consistent experience.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Self-hosted, 1 project, 2 environments, 5,000 flags per instance

plans.name: Pay-As-You-Go
plans.notes: Billed monthly by credit card, no contract, 14-day trial. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual invoiced contract, quoted per customer

hiddenCosts: API requests beyond 53M a month on Pay-As-You-Go cost $5 per million.
Enterprise add-ons include a hosted private instance, multi-region Edge, access logs and IP restrictions.
